name: Video Super Resolution
author: Echo-Storm
description: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler: a trained network that sharpens the picture one frame at a time. Made for movies, images, text and interface; a game that moves a lot is better served by the temporal upscalers. Off until you switch it on. A picture that is the same as the last (a still image, a film at 24 or 30 pictures a second on a 60 Hz or faster screen) is worked on once. The NVIDIA files it needs are in the addon's vfx folder. Choose NIS as the Scaling Type and show the picture in a window smaller than the screen. Only one upscaler works at a time.
